context:
Goal: settle Card in Hand's open choices, so Duo can plan the build.
Problem: with two pages, the bar can sit under either one, and the keys sit on the left.
Based on: decision duo-card-in-hand, your 12:25 picks (ruling); the fold and keyboard are unmeasured (measured: the runs failed at load 157).
Meanwhile: Duo plans the build and starts nothing until you answer.

designs.label: b) Left, on top of the keys

holds: Duo's build plan for Card in Hand waits on this.

options.gain: The left thumb keeps the keys; the bar never jumps.
options.label: Under the right page, always
options.lose: Differs from degen, which puts it on the left.

options.how: The bar rides above the keys.
options.label: Under the left page, on top of the keys
options.lose: Jumps 256pt each time the keys rise or fall, and crowds the query.

options.label: Under the left page, as degen does
options.lose: On mail day you must drop the keys to change tabs.

ref: Duo design round 2, draft PR #144 (Card in Hand screens)
title: Where does the tab bar sit on the open Duo?
why: It never moves and never hides behind the keys.
